reviews.x: I'm a female in my 50s (hence the mattes) who has never worn much make-up.  What little make-up I do wear I like to look very natural, which is another reason I wanted to try this palette.  What I discovered was that the lighter and more muted shades are very pretty; however, they don't seem to have much pigment. I have been using this pallet for about a year and half now...It’s basically an everyday wear for me.. I’ve been doing my makeup a very long time, and this is the best one I have found for the price! I just reordered another one. It is a little shimmery, but I like that. It stays on for me pretty well throughout the day. And like any eyeshadow, if I really want to ensure it holds, I just put on eyeshadow primer first. I definitely recommend this eyeshadow if you’re on the fence about it.

Purchased this around Christmas when Amazon had the MOST AWESOME SALE WITH FREE SHIPPING!!!!! I read the reviews and some people complained that the colors were not pigmented enough. I have a naturally brown complexion and the colors showed up on me just fine. These are "nude" colors so they won't be as pigmented as your green and blue colors. I like the colors because they're natural looking but enough to see you're wearing eye shadow.

I absolutely love this eye shadow palette. The colors were not as I expected, as I had expected them to be either too dark or too light for my complexion. However, the colors are exactly as they say they are, being nude colors; some of them matched my skin tone so well, it was hard to tell I had eye shadow on unless the glitter/shine of them was caught by the lighting. Then again, I prefer nude eye shadows to actually be nude.

Going into this I knew not to expect much for this product considering the price. The palette looks just like the picture but it is very flaky and often colors mix. Only a few colors actually show up but even then they look muddy. I was surprised, however, by how fast the palette arrived. This is a good pallets if you are just starting out with makeup but it isn't much. You get what you pay for.

reviews.t: These eyeshadows are truly fantastic. They are high quality and low priced
reviews.x: I'm a proffesional Make-Up Artist in Hollywood.  These eyeshadows are truly fantastic.  They are high quality and low priced. You do have to use the right brushes with them, for the best results. I suggest using a flat brush to apply both light and dark colours. Use a different brush for each colour. They will blend well and stay on. Enjoy !

reviews.t: and is good for everyday use
reviews.x: The colors are as expected, and it is a powder eye shadow. My only complaint is that you should reapply it midway through the day. Despite this, the product lasts a decent amount of time, and is good for everyday use. The product does not cause any irritation, and is easy to apply/remove.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the palette as a great value for the price.
Many reviewers appreciate that the shadows are truly matte, which they find hard to locate.
Several reviewers note the colors are beautiful and the palette offers a nice range of shades.
Some reviewers report pigment or application issues, saying the shadow needs primer or many coats to show up and stay on.
A few reviewers mention shipping was faster than expected, though some report damaged or poor packaging.
